description: Which naming series each user's Sales Invoices and Sales Returns get, per company.

fields.label: Rules
fields.description: Normal invoices by the user in that company get the Invoice Series; Sales Returns (credit notes) get the Return Series. Enforced on the server for the desk, the REST API and the VanSaleX app; whatever series the request carried is replaced. Existing invoices are never renamed. Series must first exist under Selling Settings → Document Naming → Sales Invoice.

fields.label: Users Without a Rule
fields.options:
Use ERPNext default series
Block Sales Invoice creation
fields.description: Use ERPNext default series: they keep ERPNext's normal behaviour (the Series on the invoice; returns switch to its -RET- series). Block: they can't create Sales Invoices or Sales Returns until they get a rule. Administrator (scheduler jobs, Auto Repeat, Subscriptions) is never blocked.

name: ZG Sales Invoice Naming Settings
